description: This file contains unit tests for the NodeAppModel class, testing various functionalities such as deep link handling, command execution, watch messaging, notification authorization, and UI interactions within the application. It defines mock classes for services and contains multiple test functions decorated with @Test and @MainActor to verify correct behavior under different scenarios.
